properties.description: Persistent URI identifying this surface record.
Fixed type token identifying this record as a surface (maps to crm:E25_Man-Made_Feature).
URI of the heritage-object, architectural-space or building that this surface is recognised on (crm:P56i_is_found_on).
Getty AAT URI for the primary surface material, e.g.: painted plaster (300014927), stucco (300014927), stone (300011176), fresco (300177433), gold leaf (300263998). Maps to crm:P45_consists_of.
Getty AAT URI for the application or fabrication technique, e.g.: fresco (300053343), oil painting (300178684), polishing (300053344). Maps to crm:P33_used_specific_technique.
Date or period label of the phase in which this surface was applied or last significantly altered, e.g. "1690–1710", "post-1945 restoration". Maps to crm:P4_has_time-span.
Positional context of the surface within the architectural element, e.g. "vault intrados", "north wall", "floor", "exterior facade". Maps to crm:P3_has_note.
Brief description of the current conservation condition of this surface, e.g. "stable", "localised cracking", "active moisture ingress". Maps to crm:P44_has_condition.
URI of a condition-assessment record (ogc.heritage.condition-assessment) that provides detailed pathology documentation for this surface.
URI of the archival or survey source (ogc.heritage.source-carrier or ogc.heritage.digital-surrogate) that documents this surface's existence and attributes. Maps to crm:P70i_is_documented_in.
Workflow status of this record, e.g. "draft", "reviewed", "approved".

GeoJSON Geometry delineating the spatial extent of this surface as a polygon or surface-patch. Coordinates should be in the reference system of the host structure's survey (local or EPSG:4326). Maps to geojson:geometry.
